description: Snowflake Scripting RESULTSET and cursor plumbing: SQLROWCOUNT after a DML (an INSERT of three rows and a DELETE of two), RESULTSET_FROM_CURSOR over an OPENed cursor returned as a table, and the rs := (SELECT ...) RESULTSET assignment form iterated with FOR. Converted 1:1 from scripting/ScriptResultSetAndRowCountTest (now retired); the RESULTSET_FROM_CURSOR test asserted only a row COUNT, so the converted step pins the four rows.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE invoices (id NUMBER, price NUMBER)
BEGIN INSERT INTO t VALUES (100), (200), (300); RETURN SQLROWCOUNT; END;
CREATE TABLE invoices (id NUMBER, price NUMBER)
BEGIN DELETE FROM invoices WHERE price < 30; RETURN SQLROWCOUNT; END;
CREATE TABLE invoices (id NUMBER, price NUMBER)
DECLARE c1 CURSOR FOR SELECT price FROM invoices WHERE price > 15; BEGIN OPEN c1; RETURN TABLE(RESULTSET_FROM_CURSOR(c1)); END;
CREATE TABLE invoices (id NUMBER, price NUMBER)
DECLARE rs RESULTSET; BEGIN LET total INTEGER := 0; rs := (SELECT price FROM invoices); FOR r IN rs DO total := total + r.price; END FOR; RETURN total; END;
